events.description: Three 2D circles of different sizes are drawn, and their external tangent lines are animated to intersect at three distinct points.
events.clip_query: Three circles with external tangent lines intersecting at three points

events.description: A straight line (Monge's line) is drawn passing through all three intersection points, demonstrating their collinearity.
events.clip_query: A line passing through three intersection points of tangent lines of three circles

events.description: The camera rotates to a 3D perspective, a 3D grid plane is faded in, and the 2D circles are replaced by 3D spheres.
events.clip_query: 3D spheres on a grid plane with camera rotating

events.description: 3D tangent cones are drawn wrapping around the spheres, with their vertices aligning with the 2D intersection points, while sphere opacities change to show depth.
events.clip_query: 3D tangent cones wrapping around spheres with changing opacities
